standard: Power alone is acceptable. Flag abilities when informed planning becomes unreliable, player control is removed, battle rules shift unpredictably, repeatable loops emerge, or Primary+Innate stacking creates unavoidable outcomes.

abilities.name: PRISMATIC FUR
abilities.effect: Color Change + Protean + Fur Coat + Ice Scales
abilities.reason: Both attacking and being hit continually rewrite its typing while Fur Coat and Ice Scales heavily blunt both damage categories. Even with full knowledge, the opponent lacks a stable matchup plan.
abilities.recommendation: Redesign before use; do not place in the normal pool unchanged.

abilities.name: Stop \\PN
abilities.effect: One version progressively disables a newly entered foe's ability, then typing, then moves; raid-shield events can also alter the state.
abilities.reason: It progressively deletes the opponent's battle rules and options rather than asking the player to solve a stable mechanic.
abilities.recommendation: Keep only as source/reference for a bespoke raid/boss system; exclude from the normal ability pool.

abilities.name: Storm-9
abilities.effect: Summons a random weather on entry and changes to another random weather every turn; also has weather-related extras.
abilities.reason: The field rules can change unpredictably every turn, so weather-dependent planning can become invalid through no player decision.
abilities.recommendation: Redesign to a deterministic weather cycle/choice or exclude unchanged.

abilities.name: Commissioner
abilities.effect: At end of turn randomly gains +1 Speed, Torments a foe, gains +1 Defense, forces a foe out, or gains Aqua Ring.
abilities.reason: The outcomes are materially different battle states, including forced switching, and the opponent cannot know which rule will apply next.
abilities.recommendation: Exclude from the normal pool unchanged; only revisit as a redesigned gimmick.

abilities.name: Berserk Fury
abilities.reason: If it literally forces random move selection, it removes player control rather than creating strategic uncertainty.
abilities.recommendation: Verify implementation. If forced random selection is confirmed, redesign or exclude.

abilities.name: Eternal Life
abilities.reason: A 15-turn revival is predictable; the concern is whether it can repeat indefinitely and create a stall/revival loop.
abilities.recommendation: Verify one-time versus repeatable behavior. Keep if bounded; redesign if repeatable.

abilities.name: Hollow Shell
abilities.reason: The effect is harsh but deterministic, so it can be planned around. The concern is forced one-for-one trades and abusive revival/sacrifice combinations.
abilities.recommendation: Keep provisionally; verify exact trigger and review only dangerous pairings/distribution.

abilities.name: Mind Game
abilities.reason: The summary is too vague. A narrow deterministic restriction could be fine; broad automatic move denial could erase meaningful choices.
abilities.recommendation: Verify trigger, target, duration, and exactly what is prevented before deciding.

abilities.name: Protean Maxima
abilities.effect: At the start of the turn, Mega Eevee changes into the Eeveelution matching the selected move's type, gaining that form's typing, stats, and ability.
abilities.reason: It changes typing, stats, and ability from a hidden move choice before actions resolve. It is deterministic, but opponents may not have a stable same-turn answer.
abilities.recommendation: Keep only as a species-specific mechanic with very clear transformation feedback; do not distribute broadly.

abilities.name: The Look
abilities.effect: Opposing Pokémon cannot use the same move twice in a row while the user is active.
abilities.reason: It restricts options, but the restriction is fixed, visible, and predictable once known.
abilities.recommendation: Mechanically acceptable; keep source-status warning because it is a CAP/test entry.

abilities.name: Bioengineering
abilities.reason: The form-change rule is not described well enough to know whether the opponent can predict or understand it.
abilities.recommendation: Verify exact trigger, available forms, timing, and stat/type/ability changes before deciding.
